targets.guidance: Publish stable source-plus-id identities and immutable interval payloads; express corrections as explicit supersession rather than reusing identity with changed content.
Deduplicate before mutation, preserve phenomenon chronology, and request checkpoint replay for late unique routing events or corrections.
Keep the event ledger authoritative over derived storage; never direct-append late flux into nonlinear current state or apply both original and replacement.
Treat reports and interpolated presentation state as read-only; do not emit them back as canonical mutation events.
